config.script:
data = event.data
	if data is None:
		return
	if not Navigation.Nav.navigate(data):
		return  # folder / no page: stay on the current page, keep the selection
	# Mark click so selection sync does not collapse expansion
	clickedPath = '/'.join(map(str, event.itemPath))
	self.view.custom.lastClickPath = clickedPath
	self.props.selection = [clickedPath]

transforms.code:
itemPath = None
	# value.data here is the current page path string (page.props.path)
	pagePath = value.data
	if pagePath is not None and len(value.items) > 0:
		result = Navigation.Nav.findItemIndex(value.items, page=str(pagePath))
		if result is not None:
			itemPath = "/".join(map(str, result))
	return itemPath

onChange.script:
text = currentValue.value
	text = '' if text is None else str(text).strip()
	tree = self.parent.parent.getChild('Tree')
	countLbl = self.getSibling('Count')
	if text == '':
		tree.refreshBinding('props.items')
		countLbl.props.text = ''
		return

	# Work on a plain copy (never mutate props.items in place; icons fail to remount).
	items = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(tree.props.items))
	q = text.upper()
	HIT = 'nav-search-hit'
	PARENT = 'nav-search-parent'
	found = [0]

	def mark(item, cls):
		if not cls and 'icon' not in item:
			return
		ic = dict(item.get('icon') or {})
		style = dict(ic.get('style') or {})
		base = [c for c in str(style.get('classes') or '').split() if c not in (HIT, PARENT)]
		if cls:
			base.append(cls)
		style['classes'] = ' '.join(base)
		ic['style'] = style
		ic['color'] = ''
		if not ic.get('path') and cls == HIT:
			ic['path'] = 'material/search'
		item['icon'] = ic

	def walk(nodes):
		any_hit = False
		for it in nodes or []:
			hit = q in str(it.get('label') or '').upper()
			kids = it.get('items') or []
			inner = walk(kids) if kids else False
			if hit:
				found[0] += 1
				mark(it, HIT)
			elif inner:
				mark(it, PARENT)
			else:
				mark(it, None)
			it['expanded'] = bool(inner)
			any_hit = any_hit or hit or inner
		return any_hit

	walk(items)
	n = found[0]
	if n == 0:
		# e.g. browser autofill: leave the tree as it is
		countLbl.props.text = 'no results'
		return
	tree.props.items = items
	countLbl.props.text = '1 result' if n == 1 else '%d results' % n

messageHandlers.script:
# Ticket Logger context-menu opener
	# page-scoped: every view on the page hears it - only the view whose menu was clicked acts
	sender = payload.get('sender')
	if sender and sender != self.view.id:
		return
	shared.Alerts.contextMenuTicketLog(payload['tagPath'], payload['viewName'])
